name: Suite 6: Admin Portal and Management Operations

planSteps.description: Navigate to /dev-login/admin to authenticate as admin
The admin dashboard at /dashboard loads showing the main metrics cards
The categories management page displays the categories table and Add Category button
The create category form is visible with name input
The chef applications management page renders with filter pills and applications table
The users management page displays chef accounts with role indicators
The order status audit log page renders with the audit log table
